meta.title: 旅行这样做！分分钟获得无限灵感！
meta.title_en: Travel Like This: Unlimited Inspiration in Minutes!

scenes.title_cn: 第一件事：去故事发生的场景
scenes.context: 灵感指南的三件事之一：到故事发生的经典场景，人一定要够多。
sentences: 洛杉矶，世界电影之都，听说这里连空气都充斥着灵感和故事。
Los Angeles, film capital of the world, where even the air feels like inspiration and stories.
film capital（电影之都）
第一件事：去到几个故事发生的经典场景，并且人一定要够多。
First: visit classic story settings, and with plenty of people.
story settings（故事场景）
那就去圣莫妮卡好了，码头沙滩旁边也有，最好是日落时分。
Santa Monica it is—pier and beach nearby, best at sunset.
at sunset（日落时分）
scenes.speak: Los Angeles, film capital of the world, where even the air feels like inspiration and stories. First: visit classic story settings, and with plenty of people. Santa Monica it is—pier and beach nearby, best at sunset.

scenes.title_cn: 第二件事：观察路人编故事
scenes.title_en: Second: Watch Strangers and Weave Stories
scenes.context: 在这些地方驻足，疯狂观察路人，在脑中给他们编故事。
sentences: 接下来在这些地方驻足，疯狂观察路人。
Next: linger and obsessively observe the strangers.
observe strangers（观察路人）
在脑中给他们编一段故事。
Weave a story about them in your head.
weave a story（编故事）
他们用刚刚长出的双腿迈进电影博物馆，去大师所望。
They stride into the movie museum on newborn legs, off to meet the masters.
newborn legs（新长出的双腿）
这是一对年长的美人鱼情侣，在七十岁这年刚刚修炼成人。
This pair of elderly mermaid lovers just became human at seventy.
mermaid lovers（美人鱼情侣）
他厌倦了牛腿的生活，决定找一位截然不同的伴侣，殊不知对方是比他更资深的牛仔。
He tires of cow legs and seeks a different partner, unaware she's a more seasoned cowboy.
seasoned cowboy（资深牛仔）
scenes.speak: Next: linger and obsessively observe the strangers. Weave a story about them in your head. They stride into the movie museum on newborn legs, off to meet the masters. This pair of elderly mermaid lovers just became human at seventy. He tires of cow legs and seeks a different partner, unaware she's a more seasoned cowboy.

scenes.title_cn: 第三件事：问年轻电影人
scenes.context: 参加索尼Future Filmmaker Wars，直接采访年轻创作者没灵感时的做法。
sentences: 第二件事是：去问问这些年轻电影人，没有灵感的时候会做什么。
Third: ask these young filmmakers what they do without inspiration.
young filmmakers（年轻电影人）
我觉得其实我一直在工作。
I think I just keep working.
keep working（持续工作）
我洗一个很长的澡，你会发现你的肩膀就会变得很厉害。
I take a long shower—you'll find your shoulders get really strong.
a long shower（一个长澡）
我通常在看一些有感情的东西，有些东西会让我更舒服。
I usually watch something emotional; certain things comfort me.
emotional content（有感情的内容）
我经常在重新认识David Bowie，我经常在重新认识我的女朋友。
I often rediscover David Bowie; I often rediscover my girlfriend.
rediscover（重新认识）
我通常在打电话，第一次打电话，是给我的女朋友Jack。
I usually make a call—to my girlfriend Jack.
call my girlfriend（打电话给女朋友）
scenes.speak: Third: ask these young filmmakers what they do without inspiration. I think I just keep working. I take a long shower—you'll find your shoulders get really strong. I usually watch something emotional; certain things comfort me. I often rediscover David Bowie; I often rediscover my girlfriend. I usually make a call—to my girlfriend Jack.

scenes.context: 朋友每天在同一家店吃早餐，店关门一天就感到生活被打破——固定的方式需要松动。
sentences: 有个朋友每天上班都去同一家店吃早餐，有一天那家店没有开门。
A friend ate breakfast at the same shop daily until it one day closed.
the same shop（同一家店）
他突然觉得周而复始的生活被打破了，哪怕只是从烧饼换成了油条。
His routine was shattered—even by swapping a bun for fried dough.
routine shattered（生活被打破）
他固定的方式还有很多：突然造访一个八年未见的朋友。
He breaks routine many ways: visiting a friend he hasn't seen in eight years.
unexpected visit（突然造访）
混进一场庆祝游行，哪怕只是在夜里和一帮人临时起意去铁圈店。
Joining a parade, or heading out for grilled skewers with a crowd at night.
join a parade（混进游行）
吃东西怎么会有灵感？肯定是走出去，去听铁圈店讲故事，去经历新鲜的事情。
How would eating spark ideas? You go out to hear stories and experience something new.
experience new things（经历新鲜事）
scenes.speak: A friend ate breakfast at the same shop daily until it one day closed. His routine was shattered—even by swapping a bun for fried dough. He breaks routine many ways: visiting a friend he hasn't seen in eight years. Joining a parade, or heading out for grilled skewers with a crowd at night. How would eating spark ideas? You go out to hear stories and experience something new.

practice: Visit classic story settings with plenty of people.
Watch strangers and weave stories about them.
Ask young filmmakers what they do without inspiration.
Routines need loosening to spark ideas.
Inspiration comes from hearing stories and new experiences.
pitfalls: Go where stories happen and people gather.
Weave stories about strangers in your head.
Small breaks in routine loosen your life.
Go out to hear stories and try new things.
shifts: 用 story settings（故事场景）、observe strangers（观察路人）、break the routine（打破routine）
用 weave a story（编故事）、ask creators（问创作者）、document real life（记录真实）
用 people-watching（观察人群）、unexpected visits（突然造访）、new experiences（新鲜经历）
